draft.decisive_test: A deterministic, publicly available text-to-key-value parser, implemented in Python, must be applied to a known, standardized scientific prose input (e.g., a published calibration block) and produce a structured output that matches the gold
draft.why_this_now: The current diagnostic fails due to unstructured output, which prevents any downstream validation. Without a reliable, reproducible parsing step, no scientific invention can be objectively evaluated.
